facts: Translation and scale deltas accumulated individually; quaternion rotations concatenated, unlike Maya Euler summation.
Composed runtime rotations are not claimed order independent.
Scalar part deforms standardized across part types; implementation opaque to motion system.
Rest-relative, absolute and limb-length-scaled position/rotation semantics are distinct.
Rest pose used as solver preconditioner and reconstruction orientation reference, not immutable final pose.
Secondary Jiggles limited to unselected subtrees with no feedback to keyed motion.
limits: Historical design, not local function ABI.
Does not establish local geometry/animation composition or map all semantic deform slots.
